simple.meaning: מֹץ (môts) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “chaff (as pressed out, i.e. winnowed or (rather) threshed loose).” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 8 times across Job, Psalms, Isaiah, Hosea, Zephaniah, beginning at Job 21:18. Its contexts include mountain.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to מֹץ (H4671).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.
simple.summary: מֹץ (môts) / H4671 is traced through Job 21:18, Psalms 1:4, Psalms 35:5, Isaiah 17:13 as a generated source-based concept entry.

structuredEvidence.definition: chaff (as pressed out, i.e. winnowed or (rather) threshed loose)

firstOccurrence.englishText: How often is it that they are as stubble before the wind,

timeline.evidenceText: How often is it that they are as stubble before the wind,
Let them be as chaff before the wind,

The nations will rush like the rushing of many waters: but he will rebuke them, and they will flee far off, and will be chased like the chaff of the mountains before the wind, and like the whirling dust before the storm.
But the multitude of your foes will be like fine dust, and the multitude of the ruthless ones like chaff that blows away. Yes, it will be in an instant, suddenly.
Behold, I have made you into a new sharp threshing instrument with teeth.
Therefore they will be like the morning mist,
before the appointed time when the day passes as the chaff, before the fierce anger of Yahweh comes on you, before the day of Yahweh’s anger comes on you.

definitions.full: H4671. mots [ מוֺץ ], מֹץ noun masculine Isa 29:5 chaff (Talmud מוֺצָא ᵑ7 , Arabic straw ); — ׳מ absolute Hosea 13:3 6 t.; construct Isa 17:13 ; — chaff , always as driven by wind, and always with כְּ , in simile; of wicked Job 21:18 (|| לִפְנֵי תֶּבֶן רוּחַ ), compare Psa 1:4 ; 35:5 ; Hosea 13:8 ; of hostile nations Isa 17:13 ( ׳מ הָרִים ), 29:5 (|| דַּךְ אָבָק ); hyperb. of Judah's power, תָּשִׂים כַּמֹץ גְּבָעוֺת 41:16 (|| תָּדוּשׁ וְתָדֹק הָרִים ); of passing time, יוֺם Zeph 2:2 . I, II. מוֺצָא , [ מוֺצָאָה ] see יצא . I. מוּצָק , [ מוּצֶ֫קֶת ] see יצק . II. מוּצָק see צוק .
